headline: Approved lodging house licenses for 16 and 18 Claremont Street; Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant application continued to December.
summary: Commissioners approved lodging house licenses for 16 and 18 Claremont Street, with 27 beds across the two buildings. The Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant application on Lovell Street was continued, and the applicant must appear in person.
decisions: Approved lodging house licenses for 16 and 18 Claremont Street, 2-0.
Continued the Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant application to December 3rd at 10:00 a.m., 2-0.
discussion: Icy Gaming Mart application: The applicant spoke online. The commission required the applicant to appear in person, because the place had a license revoked earlier, and the issue was considered serious.

Claremont Street lodging houses: Questions focused on where the security monitors would be. The applicant said footage from eight cameras in each building can be viewed from one monitor in the on-site office, and that the buildings have 14 parking spaces.
